title: Substitute
text: Let $$u=e^x$$, so $$dx=\frac{1}{u} du$$. The integral becomes the integral of $$\frac{1}{u \left(1+u\right)}$$.

title: Partial fractions
text: Since $$\frac{1}{u \left(1+u\right)}=\frac{1}{u}-\frac{1}{1+u}$$, the integral is $$\ln\left(u\right)-\ln\left(1+u\right)$$. Then substitute $$u=e^x$$.
